title: Rebuild robtk UIs when their plugin source changes
problem: robtk UI recipes include gui/<plugin>.c through PLUGIN_SOURCE but do not list that file as a prerequisite, so Make can leave a stale UI binary after the plugin source changes.
reproduce: Build a representative UI object, touch gui/demo.c, and ask Make whether the object is current; the baseline incorrectly returns current.
acceptance: Changing gui/<plugin>.c invalidates GTK, OpenGL object, embedded OpenGL and OpenGL shared-library targets, and rebuilding returns each target to current state.
repair: Enable secondary prerequisite expansion and add the stem-specific gui source to every robtk UI pattern rule that compiles it.

verification.limitations: BCL exercises GNU Make's real dependency decisions with a fake compiler. It does not link an LV2 UI against GTK or OpenGL.
verification.ownerCheck: Build an existing robtk-based plugin UI, edit only its gui/<plugin>.c source, and confirm the normal make command relinks the UI without make clean.
